entries.source: প্রতিটি pattern আগে structure দেখে, তারপর example মুখে বলুন। Audio button চাপলে Japanese sentence শুনতে পারবেন।
entries.target: Para sa bawat pattern, tingnan muna ang structure, pagkatapos ay bigkasin ang example. Kapag pinindot mo ang Audio button, maririnig mo ang Japanese sentence.

entries.source: verb-এর negative plain form। Lesson 17-এর সব grammar এই form দিয়ে তৈরি।
entries.target: Negative plain form ng verb. Lahat ng grammar ng Lesson 17 ay gawa sa form na ito.
行きます → 行かない
pumupunta → hindi pumupunta
食べます → 食べない
kumakain → hindi kumakain
します → しない
gumagawa → hindi gumagawa

entries.source: দয়া করে করবেন না — polite prohibition/request।
entries.target: Pakiusap huwag gawin — polite prohibition/request.

entries.source: てはいけません হলো rule/forbidden; ないでください হলো request।
entries.target: Ang てはいけません ay rule/forbidden; ang ないでください ay request.
ここで写真を撮らないでください.
Huwag kumuha ng larawan dito.
日本語を忘れないでください.
Huwag kalimutan ang Hapon.
Kailangang gawin talaga / obligado.

entries.source: Formal/polite expression; spoken Japanese-এ なきゃ may appear, কিন্তু এখানে polite form শিখুন।
entries.target: Formal/polite expression; sa spoken Japanese ay maaaring lumitaw ang なきゃ, ngunit dito ay aralin ang polite form.

entries.source: আশিতা মাদে নি রেপোতো ও দাসানাকেরে বা নারিমাসেন।
entries.target: 明日までにレポートを出さなければなりません.

entries.source: কাল পর্যন্ত রিপোর্ট জমা দিতে হবে।
entries.target: Kailangang isumite ang report hanggang bukas.

entries.source: না করলেও চলবে / করতে হবে না।
entries.target: Okay lang kahit hindi gawin / hindi kailangang gawin.
Nangangahulugan ito na walang obligation, hindi pagbabawal.
明日来なくてもいいです.
Okay lang kahit hindi ka dumating bukas.
靴を脱がなくてもいいです.
Okay lang kahit hindi mo hubarin ang sapatos.

entries.source: object-কে contrast/topic করলে を এর জায়গায় は আসে।
entries.target: Kung gagawing contrast/topic ang object, pumapalit ang は sa を.
